apps.name: Photos Backup
apps.localizedDescription:
#### Changed

* Updated the build toolchain to Xcode 26.3 so release builds include continued background backup on iOS 26.
* Added saved photo revisions to detect edits during foreground backups and when photo-library change history is unavailable.
* Updated the release workflow to refresh the installation feed after the IPA finishes uploading.
* Cleaned up Swift concurrency warnings and outdated project documentation.

#### Fixed

* Fixed edited photos being skipped because an older version was already marked as backed up.
* Fixed Live Photo motion and pre-edit copies being skipped when rechecking a backup.
* Prevented older uploads from marking a replacement photo as complete after an edit.
* Kept partial background scans from repeatedly restarting the same queued edits.

#### Notes

* Version 0.3.8, build 16.
* The first scan after updating rechecks the selected albums. Matching files already in Google Photos are not uploaded again.
* 202 tests passing, with 2 opt-in live tests skipped. Checked on the iOS 26.5 Simulator; live Google uploads and device background execution were not tested for this update.
* Install this fork's IPA through SideStore or AltStore. The upstream source will not install updates from this fork.
* The IPA and SHA-256 checksum are built from the release tag through GitHub Actions.
